text: **Hint 1:** Consider how L2 regularization affects the complexity of a model. Does it make the model more or less complex? How might this impact the variance of the model's predictions on the training set?\n\n**Hint 2:** Think about the trade-off between bias and variance when regularization is applied. How does L2 regularization influence this trade-off, particularly in terms of the model's performance on the training data?
